questions.stem: A 30-year-old male is brought to the emergency department by law enforcement officers after being found disoriented and agitated at a public place. The officers suspect substance abuse. As a part of the management, the medical officer plans to test for substances regulated under the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act in India. Which of the following substances that the patient might have abused is NOT included under the NDPS Act?
